name: BoolODE initial conditions
description: BoolODE initial-condition table consumed as the model_initial_conditions file. Each row stores Python-literal lists of genes and starting values.
validation_notes: Genes must be a Python-literal list of gene identifiers present in the BoolODE Boolean model.
Values must be a Python-literal list of numeric values with the same length as Genes.
BoolODE applies provided values to matching gene/protein state variables and falls back to small default values for unspecified genes.
